posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
The latest update to the OblivAeon Kickstarter(written by Christopher this time around) covered several important key things: http://tinyurl.com/z4gzalg

1) Christopher loves us.

2) OblivAeon will take a little longer than expected, but Christopher is confident enough to say we WILL get our rewards from the campaign in the first half of 2017.

3) Those who had pledge levels that included Vengeance, Shattered Timelines and Wrath of the Cosmos will be getting their copies by the end of the month(barring Fright Train derailing or something like that), and GTG will float the bill for the shipping.

4) And the most awesome bit of news(I personally think) is that we wilol be recieving 3 NEW ENVIRONMENTS INCLUDED INTO OBLIVAEON!

These new environments include:

~The militerized industrial city of Mordengrad(Home to a certain villain)

~The Maerynian Refuge(the new home of Tempests people here on Earth)

~Champion Studios( A big movie company located in San Alonso)

 

Edit: Added in the url to the update.

Edit: Changed thread title from 'Latest' to 'December'.

posts.cooked:
Also, Christopher will appear as a cameo on every card.

Yeah, I'm also baffled as to why the studio is so important to the main storyline.  I can certainly see it being important to a few secondary characters, like Ambuscade/Stuntman and maybe Guise, but that's about it.

Mordengrad makes sense story-wise--I'd forgotten Baron Blade was actually still based there, I kept thinking he was sort of nomadic on his flying defense platforms and whatnot--but do we really need another military/industrial area?  Seems like Fort Adamant and Dok'Thorath, and some cards in Mobile Defense Platform and The Block, cover that pretty well already.
